catalog.name: GitLab
catalog.description: Trigger a patrol on a GitLab push, merge request, or issue. Open a merge request with the patrol's result.
catalog.author: Myra

trigger.summary: New push, merge request, or issue matching your rules

actions.label: Open a merge request
actions.summary: Push the patrol's worktree branch and open it as a draft merge request

config.label: GitLab project
config.description: Numeric project id or URL-encoded group/project path.

config.label: Target branch
config.placeholder: Defaults to the project's default branch

config.label: Title
config.description: Leave blank to use the patrol card's title.

config.label: Description
config.description: Leave blank to use the run's result.

config.label: GitLab instance URL
config.description: Self-hosted? Point this at your instance, e.g. https://gitlab.mycompany.com.

config.label: Personal access token
config.description: Zero-setup auth: a PAT with the "api" scope. Set this OR the OAuth fields below, not both — a PAT here skips OAuth entirely.

config.label: GitLab OAuth application ID
config.description: Register an Application on your GitLab instance (User Settings → Applications, or Admin → Applications on self-hosted) with the "api" scope, then Connect below. Only needed if you're not using a Personal Access Token.

config.label: GitLab OAuth refresh token
config.description: Set automatically by Connect — leave blank.

config.label: Webhook secret token
config.description: Set the same value as the GitLab project webhook's "Secret token" field.
